|game_text=Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Temporary Foothold]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-20-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Temporary Foothold]] (original, release sheet of 16 December 2011); [[Temporary Foothold (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Temporary Foothold (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Temporary Foothold]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011; the slip [[:File:VB7-04-Temporary_Foothold.png]] and the Players Committee card image [[:File:VB7-L-temporaryfoothold-pre.gif]] print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"), page 4, slip 21 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck.” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 30) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=30, page 30. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=30 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Temporary Foothold (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) writes the number: “draw up to 2 cards” (the slip has “two”). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1274_20">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the same text is in the VMasterType list (captures of 21 July 2012, 11 December 2012 and 11 January 2013)</ref>: “Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to 2 cards from Reserve Deck.” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Temporary Foothold (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-temporaryfoothold-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Temporary Foothold]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 30)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Temporary Foothold]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-20-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
